Delete works from both normal and archived views, with cancel leaving everything intact. Refresh **http://maker:4001**.

**Flow 7 — permanent delete.**
1. On any bookmark, click **Delete** (shown in red). Instead of removing it, the entry turns into a **confirmation** that names the bookmark and spells out that this is *permanent and cannot be undone — unlike Archive, which only hides it*.
2. Click **Cancel** — the bookmark is left exactly as it was.
3. Click **Delete** again, then **Delete permanently** — now it's gone for good.
4. This also works from inside the **Archived** view, so you can clear out archived items you're sure about.

Confirm this feels right. If so, that settles the **reading-list / archive / delete** part of organising, and the remaining pieces are the two you flagged earlier: **tags** (freeform, many per bookmark) and **notes** (your own text on a bookmark) — both of which will also become searchable. Shall I move on to tags next?
